text: いあいぎりは　ひでんの　わざ　いちど　おぼえると　かんたんには　わすれられぬのじゃ

structure.jp: いあいぎりは　ひでんの　わざ
いちど　おぼえると
かんたんには　わすれられぬのじゃ

patterns.name: 〜と (when/if)
patterns.explanation: と after a plain verb means 'whenever this happens, that follows'. いちど おぼえると = 'once it's learned'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (potential)
patterns.explanation: られ means 'can', and ぬ is an old-fashioned ない, 'not'. わすれられぬ = 'cannot be forgotten'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: のだ adds a feeling of 'you see, that's how it is'; のじゃ is the old-man way of saying it. わすれられぬのじゃ = 'it can't be forgotten, you see'.
